+# Contributing
+
+## Setting up the project
+
+This project uses Python 3.8+ with no external dependencies.
+
+1. Clone the repository:
+   ```bash
+   git clone https://github.com/your-org/your-repo.git
+   cd your-repo
+   ```
+
+2. Create a virtual environment:
+   ```bash
+   python -m venv venv
+   source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
+   ```
+
+3. You're ready to develop. All modules can be imported and used directly.
+
+## Running tests
+
+Tests are not yet implemented. Consider adding pytest and test coverage before submitting larger changes.
+
+To get started with tests:
+```bash
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+## Before opening a pull request
+
+1. **Code style**: Ensure your code follows PEP 8 conventions
+   - Use meaningful variable and function names
+   - Keep functions focused and concise
+   - Add docstrings to public functions
+
+2. **Testing**: If adding new functionality or fixing bugs, write corresponding tests
+
+3. **Documentation**: Update docstrings and this CONTRIBUTING guide if you change how to set up or test the project
+
+4. **Commits**: Write clear, descriptive commit messages explaining the "why" behind your changes
+
+5. **Review your changes**: Before pushing, review your diff to ensure:
+   - No debug code or commented-out lines are left behind
+   - Changes are minimal and focused on the stated goal
+   - No sensitive information is included
+
+## Questions?
+
+Feel free to open an issue to discuss potential changes before starting work on a large contribution.
